name: Should I repair or replace my water heater if the thermostat is faulty?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my water heater if the thermostat is faulty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace your water heater when the thermostat is faulty depends on several factors, including the age of your unit, the cost of the repair versus a new installation, and the overall condition of the water heater. If your water heater is over 10 years old or has other recurring issues, a replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. CG Plumbing Solutions can help you weigh these options, providing an honest assessment to guide your decision in the Las Vegas valley.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your water heater's age, repair cost, and overall condition to decide between repairing a faulty thermostat or replacing the unit.
